entities.summary: Robert Paul Bresnahan Jr. is an American politician and businessman serving as the United States representative for Pennsylvania's 8th congressional district since 2025. He is a member of the Republican Party. Rob Bresnahan was a performers & entertainers from Kingston (b. 1990-04-22, Kingston). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
